$comment: The emitted surface of the last reviewed generation: every class and member (static and prototype sections) the generator wrote, per module, read by tools/surface-scan.ps1. tools/surface-contract.ps1 checks it in CI right after the generation step: a name in this file missing from the freshly regenerated tree fails the run. This is the complement of reject-budget.json, which watches the generator's rejections, while this one watches what the generator emitted. New names are allowed and reported; adopt them by running ./tools/surface-contract.ps1 -GeneratedRoot ./generated_cpp -Update and reviewing the git diff. A loss is written back only with -Update -Force, deliberately. A single-module regeneration must not be fed here: a tree with too few classes is refused.
